title: Source-bound scheduled irrigation timing selectors TCS1 through TCS4

source.lineage: SWAP-011 targets neither irrigation.f90 nor its AFGEN implementation.
equations: TCS1: Tred = 1 - (iqreddry_day + iqredsol_day)/iptra_day for iptra_day > 1e-10, otherwise Tred=1; trigger iff Tred < AFGEN(treltab,14,dvs).
TCS2: depl=AFGEN(rawtab,14,dvs)*(awlh-awmh); cap only when depl>awlh; trigger iff awah < awlh-depl.
TCS3: depl=AFGEN(tawtab,14,dvs)*awlh; trigger iff awah < awlh-depl.

scope: four pure TCS timing equations, with independent AFGEN table input and source-preserved strictness
partial seven-knot AFGEN sentinel and endpoint semantics
named TCS1 no-transpiration/equality tests and TCS2 depletion-cap/TCS3/TCS4 strict boundary tests
100000 deterministic source comparisons per selector at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
non_goals: AWL/AWM/AWA crop-root-zone derivation or plant stress ownership
calendar/selection opportunity, irrigation amount/rate or event lifecycle
generic management parsing, transaction/retry/restart or production admission
pass_conditions: each selector matches its exact B1.11 comparison and arithmetic
AFGEN interpolation and partial-table upper clamp match the fixed source routine
strict equality and threshold sides are explicitly tested
100000 deterministic vectors per selector pass at O0 and O2 with transcript identity
